Exploratory data analysis (EDA)

First we load the libraries to be used on the project.

Code 
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
sns.set()

Next we load data.

Code 
df_test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
df_train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")

We can see that both the training and test dataframes have missing values. So we need to know to how much of the data is missing and what to do about the missing data. First we can create a dataframe combining both train and test data. Let’s call it df_full.

Code 
df_full = pd.concat([df_train, df_test], ignore_index=True, sort=False)
